data.title: Request for Wildschadenbescheinigung and claim form after wild-animal collision
data.summary: Beispielsicher AG asks Bastian Musterquell to send back the completed accident questionnaire (Schadenfragebogen) and a wild-damage certificate (Wildschadenbescheinigung) from the gamekeeper or police for his comprehensive insurance claim (Schadennummer KS-26-1109-218) after a collision with a deer on 9 November 2026. The documents must be returned within the deadline shown.
data.explanation: Your car insurer needs proof of the wild-animal collision to process your partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) claim. Get a written confirmation from the gamekeeper or the police that a deer was involved, fill in the enclosed questionnaire, and send both back by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the insurer may delay or question the claim, so act promptly — contact them if you need more time or help finding whom to ask for the certificate.
